beats.speaker: priya
beats.say: One Tuesday, two lives. Four clocks: an hour, a day, a week, a year.

beats.speaker: sharma
beats.say: Hour one, before tax. Rohan earns $12. I earn $12,019.

beats.speaker: rohan
beats.say: So his one hour beats my whole month of pay, $2,083.

beats.speaker: sharma
beats.say: Day one: $68,493. A brand-new sports car, every single morning.

beats.speaker: sharma
beats.say: Week one: $480,769. Enough for a house, paid in cash, by Friday.

beats.speaker: priya
beats.say: Year one: $25 million. Rohan would need 1,000 years to earn that.

beats.speaker: priya
beats.say: But the pay isn't the real gap. The real gap opens at midnight.

beats.speaker: rohan
beats.say: Midnight. My $68? Gone on rent, the bus and lunch. Bed.

beats.speaker: sharma
beats.say: My day cost $10,000, living large. Still $58,493 left, and it works the night shift.

beats.speaker: sharma
beats.say: Rohan's money sleeps when he sleeps. Mine never clocks out.

beats.speaker: rohan
beats.say: Alarm. Another Tuesday. And again, guess who earns what.
